item_short_desc: Rothco's US Flag Travel Cup is the perfect on-the-go mug, that highlights your patriotism.
description: Rothco's US Flag Travel Cup is the perfect on-the-go mug. It holds 16 fluid ounce and has a double-walled, stainless steel insulation to help keep drinks hot and fresh. A full color US flag is printed on the front of the cup. The cap conveniently screws off and has a flip top for easy drinking. Rothco's US Flag travel mug measures 6.75" height and 3.5" diameter at widest point. Perfect for traveling, in the car or at the office.
